text:
kai: quick design QA from the console pass — our icon-only action buttons (round) look tight; touch targets on mobile are under 44px in several places. screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/console/icon-buttons.png
sophie: yeah saw that. the visual circle is 32px but the hit area is effectively 28px due to adjacent layout. we should ensure 44x44 minimum clickable area.
andre: we already have a token `--icon-button-size: 32px` but no explicit touch token. propose adding `--touch-target-min: 44px` and applying it via padding/negative margin where needed so visuals don't have to grow. low visual impact, better accessibility.
lucy: love that. can we scope a variant token for compact rows? `--touch-target-inline: 44px` used only for inline icon controls.
kai: also a visual affordance: focus ring is subtle on these small buttons. maybe increase focus ring thickness or use `--focus-ring-offset` token for icon buttons so keyboard users can find them. currently `--focus-ring: 2px` — maybe `3px` for icon-only.
sophie: agree. small CSS patch idea:
```css
.icon-btn { width: var(--icon-button-size); height: var(--icon-button-size); position: relative; }
.icon-btn::before { /* invisible hit area */ content: ''; position: absolute; inset: calc((var(--touch-target-min) - var(--icon-button-size)) / -2); }
.icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-ring) solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset); }
```
andre: consider performance & animation: a few people reported jank when toasts animate in quickly while many icon buttons are in the header. can we simplify toast motion by reducing translate distance and using opacity-only for reduced-motion? also respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
lucy: toast perf suggestion accepted. sample toast pattern:
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .toast { transition: opacity 120ms linear; transform: none; } }
.toast { transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity 120ms linear; transform: translateY(-6px); }
```
kai: accessibility nit: icon-only buttons need visible accessible names (`aria-label`) and should expose `aria-pressed` if toggle. also tooltips should have a small delay (250ms) on hover to avoid noisy popovers on casual mouse movement.
sophie: yes — add a Storybook story for IconButton with states: default, focus-visible (keyboard), tooltip delayed, with hit area overlay visible in a debug story so engineers can test tap targets. add an accessibility story that checks for aria-label presence.
andre: we'll add `--touch-target-min: 44px` and `--focus-ring-offset: 2px` tokens to tokens/spacing.json and tokens/accessibility.json. also add toast reduced-motion rule to tokens/motion.json and update the toasts component.
lucy: i'll file the PR: 1) tokens (touch + focus + motion), 2) IconButton CSS update (hit area + focus-visible), 3) Storybook stories + snapshot at 375x667 (mobile), 4) toast motion fallback respecting reduced-motion, 5) axe smoke on new stories. tagging @frontend to review.
a11y-bot: automated check reminder: icon-only controls must have accessible name; running checklist on PR will flag missing aria-labels.
design-bot: Figma tokens updated (file: Icon System Tokens) — https://figma.redwood.example/file/icon-system (sync message)
kai: thanks — key owners: sophie (stories + visual tests), andre (CSS + toasts), lucy (tokens + PR). i'll do a quick keyboard/VoiceOver pass after merge. :seedling:
